description:
Running TPC-DS on PySpark fails with ~60 queries due to missing UnifiedExpr methods
and Polars-specific code in the DataFrame queries.

The TPC-DS dataframe queries currently use Polars-specific functions (pl.concat, pl.when)
and call methods on expressions that don't exist in the UnifiedExpr wrapper class.
This prevents TPC-DS from running on PySpark.

Root causes:
- 7 missing UnifiedExpr methods: is_between, fill_null, is_null, is_not_null, rank, over, cum_sum
- 2 missing context functions: concat() and when() - queries use pl.concat/pl.when directly
- Type unwrapping issues where UnifiedExpr isn't converted to native PySpark Column
